aiOverview.content: The 2025/2026 U.S. Men's National Flag Football Team, featuring stars like quarterback Darrell "Housh" Doucette III, Velton Brown Jr., and Ja'Deion High, recently dominated a showcase against NFL players. The roster, focused on elite flag specialists, includes Mike Daniels, Laval Davis, Nico Casares, and Laderrick “Pablo” Smith. 2025/2026 U.S. Men's National Flag Football Team Roster Highlights Darrell "Housh" Doucette III (QB/ATH): Team captain and top passer. Velton Brown Jr. (WR/DB): Key offensive/defensive playmaker. Ja'Deion High (WR/DB): Impact wide receiver/defensive back. Nico Casares (QB): Quarterback. Mike Daniels (DB/WR): Defensive specialist. Laval Davis (WR/Rusher): Versatile receiver/rusher. Laderrick "Pablo" Smith (WR/QB): Offensive threat. Aamir Brown (DB/WR): Defensive back/wide receiver. Jamie Kennedy (DB/WR): Defensive back/wide receiver. Shawn Theard Jr. (Rusher/WR): Rusher. Michael Better (Rusher/C): Rusher/Center. Johnluis "LuLu" Hernandez (C/DB): Center/Defensive back. Antonio Coleman (QB/Rusher): Quarterback/Rusher. Noah Bickley (WR/C): Wide receiver/Center. 2025 U.S. Women's National Flag Football Team Highlights Vanita Krouch (QB): Veteran quarterback. Addison Orsborn (Collegiate select): Ottawa University. Ashlea Klam (Collegiate select): Keiser University. London Jenkins (Collegiate select): Florida Gateway College. Note: The roster for the March 2026 Fanatics Flag Football Classic included several core members of the U.S. National team.
